gold_sql:
SELECT ST_Value(rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-95.811683 29.790485)',4326)) AS elevation
FROM public.dem_us
WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-95.811683 29.790485)',4326))
LIMIT 1;
